raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

For hybrid DSA pools (`HybridLinearKVPool` with `use_dsa`, e.g. GLM-5.3-Flash: KDA + DSA layers) `setup_state_kv_args` registers `StateType.DSA` / `DSA_TAIL` from the target's `full_kv_pool` only. An EAGLE/NEXTN draft on such a model owns a single-layer DSA pool whose indexer cache is never transferred, so after a PD handoff the decode-side draft runs its top-k over an all-zero index for every prompt position. Prompts up to `index_topk` are unaffected; above it MTP acceptance drops and per-user decode speed on PD falls well below aggregated serving.

The pure-DSA branch (`DSATokenToKVPool` target, DeepSeek-V3.2 / V4 NEXTN) already ships the draft's indexer cache; the hybrid branch does not.

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/utils.py`: in the hybrid branch, after the target's DSA components, register the draft's index cache and kpool tail as `StateType.DSA` / `DSA_TAIL` components of their own, with the draft layer ids remapped above `num_hidden_layers` (`_remap_draft_layer_ids`). The target's components are untouched, so `slice_dsa_tail_dst_ptrs_for_pp` keeps its equal key/score halves per component and a peer without a draft simply registers fewer trailing components. A draft pool whose page / kpool / tail geometry differs from the target's is skipped with a warning.

New CPU unit test `test/registered/unit/disaggregation/test_hybrid_dsa_draft_disagg_state_kv_args.py`: component layout with and without a draft, draft layer ids, geometry mismatch, non-DSA draft.

## Accuracy Tests

GLM-5.3-Flash NVFP4 (`index_topk` 2048, NEXTN 5 steps), one TP1 prefill + one TP1 decode over NIXL GPUDirect on GB300, versus an aggregated worker with identical engine args (`agg`) and a second identical aggregated worker on another node (`agg2`, the node-to-node noise floor). Same prompts on all arms, greedy, 100 prompts per length, 1600 output tokens, paired difference in MTP acceptance ± standard error.

| prompt tokens | 2.0k | 2.8k | 4.1k | 8.2k |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| before: 1P1D − agg2 | −6.8% (±1.9) | −9.6% (±2.2) | −17.5% (±1.8) | −20.2% (±1.5) |
| after: 1P1D − agg2 | −2.6% (±2.5) | −2.2% (±2.9) | −4.2% (±1.4) | −0.3% (±1.5) |
| agg − agg2 (noise) | −0.1 … −1.6% | +2.6 … −1.9% | +0.1 … −2.7% | −2.5 … +0.7% |

Memory dump at the first decode-side draft step of a 7.9k-token request: the draft pool's `index_k` / `index_k_scale` had 0 of 7850 rows populated before, and match the aggregated worker after. Both peers log `state_types=[MAMBA, DSA, DSA_TAIL, DSA, DSA_TAIL]`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Replay of a production trace on the same 1P1D pair, per-user decode tok/s at concurrency 8 / 16 / 32 / 64: 99 / 76 / 66 / 62 → 117 / 89 / 78 / 76. TTFT unchanged.

Not exercised: PP > 1 prefill, DeepSeek-V3.2 NEXTN (pure-DSA branch, untouched).

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 import random
 from collections import deque

@@ -1412,6 +1413,30 @@ def get_kv_transfer_buf_infos(pool):

+def _draft_dsa_pool(draft_token_to_kv_pool):
+    """The draft's DSA pool (own indexer cache + kpool tail), or None.
+
+    EAGLE/NEXTN drafts on DSA models get a single-layer DSATokenToKVPool, or a
+    HybridLinearKVPool wrapping one; both expose get_state_buf_infos().
+    """
+    if draft_token_to_kv_pool is None or not getattr(
+        draft_token_to_kv_pool, "use_dsa", False
+    ):
+        return None
+    pool = getattr(draft_token_to_kv_pool, "full_kv_pool", draft_token_to_kv_pool)
+    if not hasattr(pool, "get_state_buf_infos"):
+        return None
+    return pool
+
+
+def _dsa_pools_match(target_pool, draft_pool) -> bool:
+    """Whether a draft DSA pool can reuse the target's page/tail payloads."""
+    for attr in ("page_size", "index_kpool", "kpool_use_compress", "tail_extra_slots"):
+        if getattr(target_pool, attr, None) != getattr(draft_pool, attr, None):
+            return False
+    return True
+

@@ -0,0 +1,123 @@
+"""PD state registration ships the EAGLE/NEXTN draft's DSA indexer cache and
+kpool tail of a hybrid DSA model as components of their own.
+
+Hybrid DSA pools (HybridLinearKVPool with use_dsa, e.g. GLM-5.3-Flash) used to
+register StateType.DSA / DSA_TAIL from the target's full_kv_pool only, so the
+decode-side draft ran top-k over an all-zero index for the whole prompt. The
+draft's components follow the target's and keep their own key/score halves, so
+the target's pairing (including the PP tail slicing) is untouched.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.base.conn import KVArgs, StateType
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils import setup_state_kv_args
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import DSATokenToKVPool, HybridLinearKVPool
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+NUM_LAYERS = 45
+
+
+class _DsaPool(DSATokenToKVPool):
+    def __init__(self, tag, layers, page_size=64, index_kpool=4, tail_extra_slots=6):
+        self.use_dsa = True
+        self.layer_num = layers
+        self.page_size = page_size
+        self.index_kpool = index_kpool
+        self.kpool_use_compress = True
+        self.tail_extra_slots = tail_extra_slots
+        self._index = [f"{tag}I{i}" for i in range(layers)]
+        self._tails = [f"{tag}TK{i}" for i in range(layers)] + [
+            f"{tag}TS{i}" for i in range(layers)
+        ]
+
+    def get_state_buf_infos(self):
+        return self._index, [4096] * self.layer_num, [256] * self.layer_num
+
+    def get_compress_tail_buf_infos(self):
+        return self._tails, [640] * len(self._tails), [64] * len(self._tails)
+
+
+class _HybridPool(HybridLinearKVPool):
+    def __init__(self, full_kv_pool, use_dsa=True):
+        self.use_dsa = use_dsa
+        self.full_kv_pool = full_kv_pool
+
+    def get_state_buf_infos(self):
+        return ["mamba"], [8], [9]
+
+    def get_state_dim_per_tensor(self):
+        return [1]
+
+    def get_state_conv_shard_groups(self):
+        return [None]
+
+    def get_state_slice_outer_counts(self):
+        return [1]
+
+    def get_state_layer_ids(self):
+        return [0]
+
+
+class TestHybridDsaDraftDisaggStateKvArgs(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.target_dsa = _DsaPool("t", 11)
+        self.target = _HybridPool(self.target_dsa)
+
+    def _run(self, draft):
+        kv_args = KVArgs()
+        setup_state_kv_args(kv_args, self.target, draft, total_kv_layers=NUM_LAYERS)
+        return kv_args
+
+    def test_target_only_layout_is_unchanged(self):
+        kv_args = self._run(None)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            kv_args.state_types, [StateType.MAMBA, StateType.DSA, StateType.DSA_TAIL]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(kv_args.state_data_ptrs[1], self.target_dsa._index)
+        self.assertEqual(kv_args.state_data_ptrs[2], self.target_dsa._tails)
+
+    def test_draft_components_follow_the_targets(self):
+        draft = _DsaPool("d", 1)
+        kv_args = self._run(draft)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            kv_args.state_types,
+            [
+                StateType.MAMBA,
+                StateType.DSA,
+                StateType.DSA_TAIL,
+                StateType.DSA,
+                StateType.DSA_TAIL,
+            ],
+        )
+        # The target's components are exactly what the target-only layout registers.
+        self.assertEqual(kv_args.state_data_ptrs[1], self.target_dsa._index)
+        self.assertEqual(kv_args.state_data_ptrs[2], self.target_dsa._tails)
+        self.assertEqual(kv_args.state_layer_ids[1], [])
+        # The draft's index cache is its own component in the draft layer band.
+        self.assertEqual(kv_args.state_data_ptrs[3], ["dI0"])
+        self.assertEqual(kv_args.state_item_lens[3], [256])
+        self.assertEqual(kv_args.state_layer_ids[3], [NUM_LAYERS])
+        # The draft's tail keeps equal key/score halves of its own.
+        self.assertEqual(kv_args.state_data_ptrs[4], ["dTK0", "dTS0"])
+
+    def test_draft_with_different_geometry_is_skipped(self):
+        draft = _DsaPool("d", 1, page_size=128)
+        with self.assertLogs("sglang.srt.disaggregation.utils", level="WARNING"):
+            kv_args = self._run(draft)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            kv_args.state_types, [StateType.MAMBA, StateType.DSA, StateType.DSA_TAIL]
+        )
+
+    def test_draft_without_dsa_is_ignored(self):
+        kv_args = self._run(_HybridPool(None, use_dsa=False))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            kv_args.state_types, [StateType.MAMBA, StateType.DSA, StateType.DSA_TAIL]
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
